name: Level 5: 3D Minecraft Clone (Three.js)
prompt: Build a 3D Minecraft voxel clone in HTML/JS using Three.js. Requirements: 3D voxel grid world generation (grass, dirt, stone, wood tiles/textures via canvas procedural textures or data URIs), PointerLock Controls (first-person camera look + WASD movement + space jump + gravity collision against blocks), block breaking (left click) and block placement (right click with selected block type in hotbar), crosshair UI, and basic sky/lighting.
